fichas.title: Rubbish Collection Rooms
fichas.summary: Rubbish collection rooms provide temporary storage for separately collected waste in tightly closed, appropriately sized containers. They should be safely accessible to waste-disposal providers, either inside or outside the building. For qualifying buildings, model building regulations specify fire-resisting construction, fire-retarding self-closing openings from inside, direct emptying from the open air, and constant effective ventilation. Outdoor bin-storage areas may be subject to separation distances, paving, and access requirements. Commercial-refuse rooms should be at ground level near delivery areas; large waste quantities may warrant crushers or presses, and food-waste rooms must be cooled.
fichas.building_type: Residential, commercial, and other buildings with rubbish collection facilities
spaces: Paved and roofed rubbish storage area
uses: Temporarily store separately collected domestic and commercial waste
Provide waste-disposal access and direct emptying to the open air
Store rubbish bins outside buildings where required
furniture_equipment: Tightly closed rubbish bins and containers in different sizes
Rubbish containers of 240 l and 660 l
Lighting and roofing for outdoor bin areas where needed

RUBBISH COLLECTION ROOMS

Waste must be collected separately in suitable containers and be
disposed of appropriately. This objective can be achieved by the
provision of rubbish collection rooms, which are easily and safely
accessible for the waste disposal provider either within the building or in corresponding areas outside the building, for the temporary storage of waste materials. Either option should be equipped
with tightly closed rubbish bins in different sizes for the various
categories of waste ---> 0.

0 Rubbish bins (selection)

following provisions:

be at ground level and near the delivery area. Their size varies according to the size of the business; it would be about

should be provided.

spaces for rubbish bins should be at least 5 m from openings into
occupied rooms and flammable building elements, and at least
2 m from property boundaries. Areas for mobile rubbish bins are
to be paved. The distance from accessible roads should not exceed 30 m ---> f). It is also important that areas for rubbish bins

disposed of appropriately. This objective can be achieved by the
provision of rubbish collection rooms, which are easily and safely
accessible for the waste disposal provider either within the building or in corresponding areas outside the building, for the temporary storage of waste materials. Either option should be equipped
with tightly closed rubbish bins in different sizes for the various
categories of waste ---> 0.
